recipeSnapshot.heading: Captured recipe
recipeSnapshot.urlMismatch: This recipe was captured from a different link. Refresh to preview the current link.

errors.generic: The recipe could not be saved or loaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.RECIPE_NO_URL: Add a recipe link before importing.

errors.RECIPE_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: This link does not point to a supported text or recipe page.

errors.RECIPE_EXTRACTION_FAILED: No complete recipe could be extracted. Check that the page includes ingredients and instructions.
errors.RECIPE_UNSUPPORTED_FACTS: The extracted recipe could not be verified against the page. Try another recipe link.
errors.RECIPE_SOURCE_CHANGED: The recipe link changed after this preview. Close and import again.
errors.RECIPE_INVALID_REQUEST: This preview is invalid. Close and import again.
errors.RECIPE_INVALID_CONTENT: The recipe is empty or too long to save. Try another recipe page.
